bead.title: claude-tui: benchmark per-turn wall time and loop overhead against claude --print baseline
bead.description:
PROBLEM: ADR-013 §3 testing concern requires that claude-tui's loop overhead beyond inference stay under 10ms and that wall-time-per-turn stay within 2x of claude --print on an equivalent prompt. Without an enforcing benchmark, regressions in the PTY driver, session pool, or hook fan-out can silently violate these ratchets.

ROOT CAUSE:
- internal/harnesses/claudetui/: no benchmark exists that compares the PTY turn path to a claude --print baseline on a shared canned prompt.
- No assertion harness for the <10ms loop-overhead and <2x wall-time bounds.

PROPOSED FIX:
1. Add a shared canned prompt fixture and a claude --print baseline runner in the claudetui test package.
2. Add BenchmarkClaudeTuiTurnWallTime that runs N iterations of the PTY turn path, measures wall time, and computes the loop overhead by subtracting measured inference time.
3. Fail the benchmark if mean wall-time-per-turn exceeds 2x the baseline or if loop overhead exceeds 10ms.

NON-SCOPE:
- PTY turn driver and intermediate ProgressEvent emission (sibling child A).
- Session pool, /clear, orphan reaping (sibling child B).
- AccountHarness and QuotaHarness implementations (sibling child C).
- ModelDiscoveryHarness and no-static-fallback enforcement.
- Capability baseline rows, evidence IDs, ADR-013 status promotion.
- Cassette-driven static fallback for production code (forbidden by fizeau-89eca738).
- Service-side changes beyond what child #1 already wired.
- Redesigning the hook-conflict arbitration layer.

Depends on sibling children A, B, C. Governing artifacts: ADR-013 §3, CONTRACT-004.
bead.acceptance:
1) BenchmarkClaudeTuiTurnWallTime asserts mean wall-time-per-turn is within 2x of the claude --print baseline on the shared canned prompt, and that loop overhead beyond inference is under 10ms.
2) go test ./... -count=1 is green.
3) lefthook run pre-commit is green.
